# ⚔️ Weapons of Destruction

**Weapons of Destruction** brings **23 legendary items** into your world, each forged with its own distinct purpose — speed, power, ability, and absolute devastation. Every weapon and tool features custom attributes, unique combat effects, and specialized survival crafting recipes, giving players entirely new ways to fight, harvest, and dominate.

This mod is actively developed for **NeoForge** and receives frequent content updates. 

---

### 🔥 UNLEASH THE ARSENAL

*   **🗡️ Legendary Combat Weapons:** Master fast-striking lightweight blades, wield brutal heavy weapons with massive burst damage, or unleash special abilities such as shockwaves, burning slashes, or energy bursts. 
*   **🛠️ 7 Tiers of Paxels Included:** Combine the destructive utility of an **Axe, Pickaxe, and Shovel** into a single item slot! Craft Paxels for *Wood, Stone, Copper, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite* to instantly break any block in your path.
*   **💥 Custom Attributes & Visuals:** Stand out in combat with distinct, highly detailed weapon models, custom attack effects, and unique tactical advantages.
*   **⚖️ High-Risk Progression:** Hunt down rare materials and master complex crafting grids to forge endgame gear capable of challenging the toughest bosses.

---

### 📷 Gallery & Images
*Check out the **Gallery** tab at the very top of this page to see high-quality screenshots of the weapon stats, custom models, and crafting recipes before you install!*

*Created by **ZayO3**. If you have an idea for a 24th legendary item, feel free to drop a comment below and suggest it!*
